quests.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 2

dialogue.t: Hmm, I should probably take a look at the other envelopes first...
Oh, {NICKNAME}! It's been a while... Why do you look so surprised?
To see a warrior like me enjoying Lantern Rite?

dialogue.sit: I don't think I've ever seen you relax...

dialogue.t: The Tenryou Commission bears a great responsibility to the people. As a member, I cannot afford to relax most of the time.
Perhaps people think of me as a single-minded warrior, completely out of place in a festive and refined neighborhood like Hanamizaka.
But, letting down my guard means allowing crime to slip through... That is not only a detriment to my duty but to the atmosphere of Hanamizaka as a whole.
The most I can do is take advantage of any spare moment that comes my way.
Ah, apologies. I shouldn't talk about such serious matters during the holidays.
I'm trying to make a gift envelope, but it's not quite coming together. Perhaps you could give me some advice?

dialogue.sit: Sure, let me think about it for a second...

dialogue.t: I'm trying to make a gift envelope, but it's not quite coming together. Perhaps you could give me some advice?

dialogue.sit: Sure, let me think about it for a second...

dialogue.t: I see. This method produced a great result.
I appreciate the help. This souvenir really makes this trip worthwhile.
You have my thanks, {NICKNAME}. The next time you visit Inazuma, I will treat you to a round of tea.

quests.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope…
